\section*{Chapter 24 - Compliance Engineering}


\subsection*{Purpose}

This chapter demonstrates how AIM-OS enables compliance engineering through automated evidence collection, audit trail generation, and regulatory artifact production. Compliance is not a separate process—it emerges naturally from AIM-OS's built-in provenance, witnessing, and evidence systems.

\subsection*{Executive Summary}

\item Compliance artifacts are generated automatically from AIM-OS operations: VIF witnesses provide provenance, SEG maintains evidence graphs, CMC stores audit trails, and SDF-CVF ensures quality gates.
\item Regulatory requirements (GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001) map to AIM-OS capabilities: data governance (CMC), access controls (Authority), audit trails (VIF), and quality assurance (SDF-CVF).
\item Compliance dashboards surface evidence gaps, aging artifacts, and policy violations automatically, enabling proactive remediation before audits.

\subsection*{Compliance Architecture}

AIM-OS compliance architecture integrates all foundation systems:

\subsubsection*{CMC (Context Memory Core) - Chapter 5}

\textbf{CMC provides:} Bitemporal storage for compliance artifacts

\textbf{Compliance Use Cases:}
\item Store all compliance artifacts as immutable atoms
\item Enable "what was true at time T?" queries for audit purposes
\item Support data subject requests (GDPR Right to Access)
\item Maintain audit trails with bitemporal tracking

\textbf{Key Insight:} CMC enables compliance through durable, auditable storage.

\subsubsection*{VIF (Verifiable Intelligence Framework) - Chapter 7}

\textbf{VIF provides:} Complete provenance through witness envelopes

\textbf{Compliance Use Cases:}
\item Every operation generates witnesses with model ID, prompts, tools, and confidence levels
\item Witnesses provide complete audit trails
\item Enable deterministic replay for compliance audits
\item Support regulatory requirements for audit logging

\textbf{Key Insight:} VIF enables compliance through complete provenance.

\subsubsection*{SEG (Semantic Evidence Graph) - Chapter 9}

\textbf{SEG provides:} Evidence graph structure for claims and anchors

\textbf{Compliance Use Cases:}
\item Links compliance claims to supporting evidence
\item Enables contradiction detection
\item Supports evidence validation
\item Maintains evidence relationships for audit purposes

\textbf{Key Insight:} SEG enables compliance through evidence traceability.

\subsubsection*{SDF-CVF (Self-Directed Feedback \& Continuous Validation Framework) - Chapter 10}

\textbf{SDF-CVF provides:} Quality validation and quartet parity

\textbf{Compliance Use Cases:}
\item Ensures quartet parity (code/docs/tests/traces) for compliance artifacts
\item Quality gates prevent non-compliant changes
\item Validates compliance requirements continuously
\item Maintains quality standards for regulatory artifacts

\textbf{Key Insight:} SDF-CVF enables compliance through continuous quality validation.

\textbf{Overall Insight:} Compliance architecture integrates all foundation systems to enable comprehensive compliance engineering.

\item \textbf{Implementation:} Query CMC for all personal data with \texttt{valid\_time} filtering

\item \textbf{Evidence:} SEG maintains evidence of deletion decisions

\item \textbf{Evidence:} Export operations logged with VIF witnesses

\item \textbf{Implementation:} Every operation generates witness with data processing details
\item \textbf{Evidence:} Complete provenance for all data processing

\subsection*{Compliance Artifacts}

AIM-OS generates compliance artifacts automatically from operations:

\subsubsection*{Audit Trails}

\textbf{Source:} VIF witnesses stored in CMC

\textbf{Content:}
\item Complete operation history
\item Model ID, prompts, tools used
\item Confidence levels and decisions
\item Timestamps and context

\textbf{Use Case:} "What operations accessed this data?" → Audit trail shows complete history

\subsubsection*{Evidence Graphs}

\textbf{Source:} SEG maintains evidence relationships

\textbf{Content:}
\item Compliance claims linked to evidence
\item Supporting anchors (papers, policies, tests)
\item Contradiction detection results
\item Evidence validation status

\textbf{Use Case:} "What evidence supports this claim?" → Evidence graph shows supporting anchors

\subsubsection*{Quality Reports}

\textbf{Source:} SDF-CVF generates quality metrics

\textbf{Content:}
\item Quartet parity scores (code/docs/tests/traces)
\item Quality gate pass rates
\item Validation results
\item Compliance checklist status

\textbf{Use Case:} "Is this system compliant?" → Quality report shows compliance status

\subsubsection*{Access Logs}

\textbf{Source:} Authority system tracks access decisions

\textbf{Content:}
\item All access decisions
\item Authority tier assignments
\item Override records
\item Escalation history

\textbf{Use Case:} "Who accessed this data?" → Access logs show all access decisions

\textbf{Key Insight:} Compliance artifacts are generated automatically from AIM-OS operations, ensuring comprehensive compliance coverage.

\subsection*{Compliance Workflows}

AIM-OS enables structured compliance workflows:

\subsubsection*{Data Subject Request (GDPR)}

\textbf{Workflow Steps:}

1. \textbf{Request Received:} Data subject requests access to personal data
   - Request logged in CMC with VIF witness
   - Timeline entry created for tracking

2. \textbf{Query CMC:} Use bitemporal queries to retrieve all data for subject
   - Query CMC with }valid\_time\texttt{ filtering
   - Retrieve all personal data atoms
   - Filter by data subject identifier

3. \textbf{Generate Report:} Create structured export with all personal data
   - Format data in structured format (JSON, CSV)
   - Include metadata and timestamps
   - Generate export file

4. \textbf{Audit Trail:} Record request and response in CMC with VIF witness
   - Store request details in CMC
   - Store response details in CMC
   - Generate VIF witness for audit

5. \textbf{Evidence Link:} Link report to SEG evidence graph for validation
   - Create SEG claim for data subject request
   - Link to export file as anchor
   - Link to audit trail as evidence

\textbf{Success Criteria:} Request fulfilled, audit trail complete, evidence linked

\subsubsection*{Security Incident Response (ISO 27001)}

\textbf{Workflow Steps:}

1. \textbf{Incident Detected:} CAS detects security violation or anomaly
   - CAS monitors system continuously
   - Detects security violations
   - Creates incident alert

2. \textbf{Timeline Creation:} Create timeline entry with incident details
   - Record incident in timeline
   - Include incident details
   - Tag with security incident type

3. \textbf{Evidence Collection:} Gather VIF witnesses, SEG claims, and CMC atoms
   - Collect VIF witnesses for incident
   - Gather SEG claims related to incident
   - Retrieve CMC atoms for context

4. \textbf{Root Cause Analysis:} Use SEG to trace incident to root cause
   - Query SEG for incident-related claims
   - Trace to root cause through evidence graph
   - Identify contributing factors

5. \textbf{Remediation Plan:} Create APOE plan for incident remediation
   - Create APOE chain for remediation
   - Include remediation steps
   - Set success criteria

6. \textbf{Audit Trail:} Store complete incident response in CMC
   - Store incident details in CMC
   - Store remediation plan in CMC
   - Generate VIF witness for audit

\textbf{Success Criteria:} Incident resolved, root cause identified, remediation complete

\subsubsection*{Compliance Audit Preparation (SOC 2)}

\textbf{Workflow Steps:}

1. \textbf{Evidence Gathering:} Query SEG for all compliance-related claims
   - Query SEG for compliance claims
   - Filter by regulation type
   - Collect supporting evidence

2. \textbf{Artifact Generation:} Export audit trails, access logs, and quality reports
   - Export audit trails from CMC
   - Export access logs from Authority system
   - Export quality reports from SDF-CVF

3. \textbf{Gap Analysis:} Identify missing evidence or policy violations
   - Compare evidence to requirements
   - Identify gaps in coverage
   - Flag policy violations

4. \textbf{Remediation:} Create tasks for evidence gaps
   - Create APOE tasks for gaps
   - Assign owners and deadlines
   - Track remediation progress

5. \textbf{Validation:} Verify all artifacts meet audit requirements
   - Validate artifact completeness
   - Verify evidence quality
   - Confirm compliance coverage

\textbf{Success Criteria:} All artifacts generated, gaps identified, remediation planned

\subsection*{Compliance Dashboards and Monitoring}

AIM-OS provides automated compliance dashboards that surface evidence gaps, aging artifacts, and policy violations:

\subsubsection*{Evidence Gap Detection}
\item \textbf{Missing Artifacts:} Identifies compliance requirements without supporting evidence
\item \textbf{Aging Artifacts:} Flags compliance artifacts approaching expiration dates
\item \textbf{Policy Violations:} Detects operations violating compliance policies
\item \textbf{Coverage Gaps:} Highlights regulatory requirements without AIM-OS coverage
